notes: The official table lists four standard prices and says swap-free accounts cost 10% more.
The official article says there is no recurring or monthly fee.
There is no daily loss limit.
The maximum-loss floor moves up with new profit highs, does not move down after losses, and cannot rise above the initial balance.
The official article says Stellar Instant has no consistency rule for lot size, trade frequency, or daily performance pattern.
The platform article applies to CFD Stellar Instant accounts, not FundedNext Futures.
U.S.-based traders are limited to Match-Trader and do not receive MT4 or MT5.
Swap charges remain part of account profit and loss even though overnight and weekend holding are allowed.
News trading is allowed, but only 40% of profit from trades executed inside the named 10-minute window counts.
Losses remain the trader's responsibility, and the adjustment is calculated after the cycle ends.
Copying is allowed only between Stellar Instant accounts owned by the same individual.
Copying between Stellar Instant and Stellar 1-Step, 2-Step, or Lite is prohibited even when the owner is the same.
FundedNext recommends one device and a consistent IP address.
VPN and VPS services are permitted; the article recommends paid services with dedicated IPs.
EAs and indicators must be customized to the trader's strategy and may not exploit platform mechanics.
Restricted or exploitative strategies can cause a permanent breach.
The $20,000 limit applies to combined active new purchases.
The same article separately states that performance scaling can reach 10 times the initial balance and a published maximum of $2 million.
The official scale-up article says the share is 70% in tiers 1 and 2 and 80% from tier 3 onward.
At 5% growth, on-demand eligibility is checked at end of day.
Opening a new trade disables the transfer option until the next EOD check confirms that 5% growth still holds.
Growth of at least 1% but below 5% uses the 14-day route.
The reward share moves to the FundedNext Wallet before the payout request.
A submitted withdrawal request cannot be cancelled.
The maximum-loss floor remains at its highest reached level after a withdrawal.
The official example says withdrawing the full profit after the floor has capped at the initial balance can leave balance equal to the floor and breach the account.

reset.conflict: The article says every reset is 10% below list price, but its published $2,000 row shows $56.99 against a $59.99 list price. That row is not a 10% reduction, so the reset amount must be confirmed in checkout.

notes: The official article says the refundable-fee policy applies to challenge products, not Stellar Instant.
